ruler.name: King Lorien
ruler.bio: Lorien has held the crown of Gala for as long as he has willed it, and no other king of Gala is named in any record men have seen. He led the Gala in King Edran's Grand Alliance, remembers the War of Men, Dardan, the fall of Aenor and the Necromancer's reign, and speaks of Dardan as if it were last year. He advised Edran against the Ember Lands campaign, buried his dead in the Garden of the Dead at Sodoli when the advice was not taken, and has been courteous to Aenor and distrustful of kings who turn victories into crowns ever since.

portrait.appearance: An elf king of immeasurable age and calm power, ageless face, gold hair, eyes that have seen a great deal.
portrait.dress: White robes worked with sun-gold, a slender crown of white gold, an old sword at his side.

ruler.definedBy: characters spec (zin_lorien; ruler id is the contract id)
ruler.note: No birth year or age (V23). Lorien's later deeds (Eindil, the servant of the black north) are story events and appear nowhere in his start text.

heir.note: No heir is named in any record: Lorien holds the crown for as long as he wills. Who follows him after zin_lorien_dead is left to the owner and the Gala tree.

advisors.name: Caleon, Keeper of the Mirror
advisors.office: Keeper of the Mirror of First Rain
advisors.role: Keeps the spring of the Mirror Vigil and its bowl of rain, and trusts no vision that shows itself too plainly.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man holding a water-filled bowl of white stone.

advisors.name: Calien, Steward of the Shore
advisors.role: Looks after the Sunfolk villages that farm the shore below the dormant Good Volcanoes, and knows every village elder by name.
advisors.portrait: An elf in plain white with a farmer's straw hat in his hand.

advisors.name: Caliel, Envoy to the Noon Council
advisors.role: Sits in the guest's seat the Noon Council keeps for Gala, and owes the Sunhot nothing but courtesy, which he pays in full.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man in sun-gold with a guest's white sash.

advisors.name: Calion of the Garden
advisors.office: Keeper of the Garden of the Dead
advisors.role: Keeps the garden at Sodoli where the Gala dead of Dardan and the Ember Lands are remembered, far from both places.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man among white stone and flowering trees.

advisors.name: Ondion, Master of the White Ships' Yards
advisors.role: Keeps the court's white ships, built by the shipwrights of Ossi Luni and the fastest in the south.
advisors.portrait: An elf with a shipwright's rule beside a white hull.

commanders.name: Venion of the Ancient Blades
commanders.role: Captain of the ancient swordsmen of the court, who fought at Dardan beside his king and has not hurried since.
commanders.portrait: A tall elf in white-gold mail with a long two-handed sword.

commanders.name: Tangsiel of the Sunward Guard
commanders.role: Commands the Sunward Guard of the court and its watch on the dry shore.
commanders.portrait: An elf guard captain in sun-gold mail.

commanders.name: Sulestien, Master of the King's Ships
commanders.role: Commands the court's white ships, the fastest in the south.

figures.name: Caloth of the Mirror
figures.office: Reader of the Mirror of First Rain
figures.role: Gala's named wizard, who has kept the spring since before the Fourth Age and reads it for the king; a reading costs his days of sleep, and he does not explain what he reads.
figures.portrait: A pale elf-man with water-dark eyes beside a still spring.
figures.recruit: Story figure of the Mirror Vigil for events; Heveneya holds the advisor seat. The owner may wish to merge the two.
figures.note: What the Mirror shows is belief (V18) and is never stated as fact.

ruler.name: Radiant Speaker Salin of Eldoga
ruler.bio: Salin of Eldoga was chosen Radiant Speaker by the sanctuaries and will serve until he lays the office down, and he chairs the Noon Council of the Sunhot realms. He leads the eastern lowland and the Sun Grasslands, the largest realm of the region, peaceful and prosperous, where the elves of the Light are few among a great many Sunfolk farmers. Since the pirates of the Bright Sea raided the grassland coast, the Radiant Speaker must ask the villages for every levy, and the villages may refuse; Salin has never yet had to ask.

portrait.appearance: A tall, gold-skinned elf with bright amber eyes and a serene, sunlit face; no visible age.
portrait.dress: White and gold sanctuary robes, a sunburst collar of beaten gold, an open hand raised in greeting.
portrait.colours: Sun gold (#e0a02a), noon white (#f2e6c4), clay red (#b04a2a).

ruler.formerName: Radiant Speaker Soyan (characters spec; superseded by the histories)
ruler.note: His name is one letter from the sanctuary of Sali inside his realm; kept as the histories name him. See the owner questions.

heir.note: No heir: the sanctuaries choose the next Radiant Speaker when the present one lays the office down.

advisors.name: Elang of the Villages
advisors.role: A Sunfolk village elder who speaks for the villages that must be asked for the levies, and who reminds the Radiant Speaker that they may say no.
advisors.portrait: A sun-browned farmer-man with a staff of woven grass.

advisors.name: Helang of the Sanctuary Roads
advisors.role: Keeps the sanctuary roads open for the pilgrims and the Noon Council's couriers.
advisors.portrait: A tall elf in a white travelling cloak with a sun-staff.

advisors.name: Elan, Clerk of the Noon Council
advisors.role: Keeps the council's rolls of quarrels settled, including the weaving contest that both Elvana and Igara walked out of.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man with a scroll of the council and a reed pen.

commanders.name: Poyan of the Sun Guard
commanders.role: Commands the tall elven guards of the sanctuaries, who have not fought since the pirates of the Bright Sea.
commanders.portrait: A very tall elf guard in gilded scale with a long spear.

commanders.name: Hele of the Grasslands
commanders.role: A Sunfolk man who leads the grassland levies when the villages agree to send them.
commanders.portrait: A Sunfolk man with a spear and a sun-bleached cloak.

ruler.name: Speaker Elan of Googavis
ruler.bio: Elan was chosen Speaker by the sanctuary of Googavis and has argued Elvana's cause at the Noon Council longer than anyone there can remember. He leads the Cape of Elvana and the Elvini shore, a small, gentle house of weavers and healers. His only quarrel in the world is with Igara over the sun-cranes of the Sun Lake Shallows, fought with songs, weavings and petitions, and he would not give it up for anything.

portrait.appearance: A tall, gold-skinned elf-man with a patient, amused face and long braided hair; no visible age.
portrait.dress: A woven robe of saffron and white in the cape's patterns, a crane-feather pin, a weaver's shuttle on a cord.
portrait.colours: Terrace gold (#d89a2a), noon white (#f2e6c4), clay red (#a8452a).

ruler.formerName: Elvae (named after the realm; renamed under the place-name rule)

heir.note: No heir: the sanctuary of Googavis chooses each Speaker.

advisors.name: Elang of the Looms
advisors.role: Leads the weavers of the cape, whose cloth the Noon Council once judged equal to Igara's, which he has not accepted.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man at a loom with crane patterns in the cloth.

advisors.name: Sengi the Healer
advisors.role: Leads the healers of the sanctuary, who heal with warmth gathered from the noon.
advisors.portrait: A gentle elf with warm hands held over a bowl of light.

advisors.name: Hele of the Cranes
advisors.role: Composes the petitions and crane-songs that Elvana sends to the Noon Council against Igara, two a season.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man with a crane feather and a sheaf of songs.

commanders.name: Tanga of the Cape Guard
commanders.role: Commands the tall guards of the cape sanctuaries.
commanders.portrait: A tall elf guard with a spear and a saffron cloak.

commanders.name: Heli of the Elvini Shore
commanders.role: A Sunfolk captain of the shore levies.
commanders.portrait: A Sunfolk man with a fishing spear.

ruler.name: Speaker Ranin of Repgin
ruler.bio: Ranin was chosen Speaker by the sanctuary of Repgin, keeper of the shrine of the shallows, and he answers every petition of Elvana with two of his own. Igara is the smallest sanctuary realm, proud of its shrine and its sun-cranes, and it measures its standing at the Noon Council by how often it can outvote Elvana. The only time the two have ever agreed was when the council judged their weavings equal and both Speakers walked out together.

portrait.appearance: A tall, sharp-featured gold-skinned elf with a stubborn chin and bright eyes; no visible age.
portrait.dress: White robes edged with crane-grey, a shrine-key of gold, a stack of petitions under one arm.
portrait.colours: Terrace gold (#d89a2a), noon white (#f2e6c4), clay red (#a8452a).

ruler.formerName: Igan (named after the realm; renamed under the place-name rule)

heir.note: No heir: the sanctuary of Repgin chooses each Speaker.

advisors.name: Elan of the Shallows
advisors.office: Keeper of the Shrine of the Shallows
advisors.role: Keeps the shrine of the shallows and its cranes, which he calls the shrine's birds and not Elvana's.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man feeding a sun-crane in the reeds.

advisors.name: Helin the Petition-Writer
advisors.role: Writes Igara's petitions to the Noon Council, two for every one of Elvana's.
advisors.portrait: An elf with ink on his fingers and a basket of scrolls.

advisors.name: Yungi the Crane-Keeper
advisors.role: Counts the sun-cranes every spring and tells the council how many of them nested on Igara's side.
advisors.portrait: An old elf among tall grey cranes.

commanders.name: Sengan of the Shrine Guard
commanders.role: Commands the few tall guards of the shrine.

commanders.name: Elang of the Lake Levy

commanders.portrait: A Sunfolk man with a reed shield.

ruler.name: Eldest Watcher Wenang of Sudoni

title.english: Eldest Watcher of the Roll of Wings

ruler.bio: Wenang is Eldest Watcher of Sudoni and keeps the Roll of Wings, the record of every sighting of angels over the western terraces, with the hour, the weather and the watcher's name. Yeni Alang is a quiet house that farms, sings and watches, and it adds a line to the Roll a few times in a good year. When no watcher saw wings for a whole year the house fasted until the next spring, and the Sunfolk of the terraces still count a sighting as a blessing on the harvest.

portrait.appearance: A tall, slender gold-skinned elf with far-seeing grey eyes, always looking up; no visible age.
portrait.dress: Pale sky-blue robes over white, the bound Roll of Wings at his side, a reed pen behind the ear.
portrait.colours: Terrace gold (#d89a2a), noon white (#f2e6c4), clay red (#a8452a).

heir.note: No heir: the house is led by its eldest watcher.

advisors.name: Elan, Keeper of the Roll
advisors.office: Keeper of the Roll of Wings
advisors.role: Copies each sighting into the Roll and checks the watcher's account against the weather.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man bent over a great book with a sky-blue cover.

advisors.name: Ranga of the Terraces
advisors.role: Speaks for the Sunfolk terrace-farmers and their harvest, which a sighting is said to bless.
advisors.portrait: A Sunfolk farmer with a hoe and a sun-hat.

advisors.name: Elang of the High Watch
advisors.role: Keeps the watch-posts on the highest terraces, where the watchers sit through the still days.
advisors.portrait: An elf seated on a high terrace with his face to the sky.

commanders.name: Elin of Sudoni
commanders.role: Commands the guards of the terraces.
commanders.portrait: A tall elf guard on a terrace stair.

commanders.name: Hele of the Terrace Levy
commanders.role: A Sunfolk captain of the terrace levy.
commanders.portrait: A Sunfolk man with a sling on a stepped field.

ruler.name: Keeper Tangin of Wefolen
ruler.bio: Tangin is Keeper of the Stones of Tor Luni and decides what may be cut, in a sanctuary that quarries the white stone of half the realms of the region and leaves its standing stones uncut. Since a Keeper once ordered a block cut from the foot of a standing stone and the chisels broke, no Keeper has given that order again, and Tangin has no intention of being the second. He receives the pilgrims who come by sea to look out over the Sea of Gods from the high places by Wefolen.

portrait.appearance: A broad, strong-handed gold-skinned elf with white stone-dust in his hair; no visible age.
portrait.dress: A quarry-keeper's pale robe tied at the waist, a mallet of white stone, a pilgrim's sun-token.
portrait.colours: Terrace gold (#d89a2a), noon white (#f2e6c4), clay red (#a8452a).

heir.note: No heir: the sanctuary chooses its Keeper of the Stones.

advisors.role: Tor Luni's named wizard, a sanctuary-warden who heals with warmth and keeps lamps of gathered sun for night surgery; he grows cold and sick when he gives too much.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man in white holding a lamp that glows like noon.
advisors.definedBy: magic_and_wizards.md 4.5 (proposed practitioner; at Godland, the former label of Tor Luni)

advisors.name: Elang, Master of the Quarries
advisors.role: Runs the white-stone quarries and the four small quarry-sanctuaries that joined Tor Luni.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man with a measuring cord and white dust on his arms.

advisors.name: Lovang of the Standing Stones
advisors.role: Keeps the standing stones uncut and the pilgrims' paths among them.
advisors.portrait: An old elf beside a tall white standing stone.

commanders.name: Hengin of the Quarry Guard
commanders.role: Commands the guards of the high places.
commanders.portrait: A tall elf with a stone-headed spear.

commanders.name: Heng of the Pilgrim Boats
commanders.role: A Sunfolk fisher-captain who brings the sea pilgrims to the high places and takes them home again.
commanders.portrait: A Sunfolk man at the steering oar of a white boat.

ruler.name: Speaker Lovin of Hol
ruler.bio: Lovin of Hol was chosen by the island Speakers at Holang to speak for all the Ihuy isles, a council of pearl-farmers, sailors and fishers among the isle Sunhot and the Sunfolk. The council trades pearls, fish and salt with the Islands of the South and the mainland and uses the reef-words of the south for its pilots. Lovin keeps one eye on the smoke of Hol, which the isle folk say smokes harder whenever a ship is lost, and he has seen it smoke very hard this year.

portrait.appearance: A tall, sea-tanned isle elf with salt-bleached hair and a pearl-diver's easy breathing; no visible age.
portrait.dress: A teal sea-robe with a pearl collar, bare feet, a reed-pilot's knotted cord at the wrist.
portrait.colours: Lagoon teal (#2f8a8a), sun gold (#e0b23a), shell white (#f0e8cc).

heir.note: No heir: each island sends its Speaker to the council at Holang, which chooses one to speak for all.

advisors.name: Elan of the Lagoons
advisors.role: Keeps the pearl lagoons and sells their pearls to the south and the mainland.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man with a basket of pearls and wet hair.

advisors.name: Yunge the Smoke-Watcher
advisors.role: Watches the smoke of the Great Volcano on Hol and moves the council to Tei when it grows too thick.
advisors.portrait: An elf on a black-sand shore looking up at a smoking peak.

advisors.name: Pangi the Reef-Pilot
advisors.role: A Sunfolk pilot who speaks the reef-words of the south and can bring a boat through any shallows in Ihuy.
advisors.portrait: A Sunfolk sailor with a sounding-pole and a cord of reef-knots.

commanders.name: Tangi of the Island Boats
commanders.portrait: An elf captain on a teal-sailed boat.

commanders.name: Elang of Holang
commanders.role: Commands the guard of the council isle.
commanders.portrait: A tall elf-man with a shell-crested spear.

ruler.name: Tide-Speaker Yunga of Ileslia
ruler.bio: Yunga was a pilot before the Archipelago Council chose him Tide-Speaker at the turn of the tide, as every Tide-Speaker has been chosen since the council was founded. The northern isles build the white ships of the south and the hulls of Gala's court, trade on the Bright Sea and grow rich on the fastest ships anywhere. His is the one realm of the region whose ships could carry a host north if the Noon Council ever asked, and he hopes it never will.

portrait.appearance: A lean, tanned isle elf with a pilot's squint and sea-salt in long dark hair; no visible age.
portrait.dress: A white sailing coat over teal, a tide-staff carved with reef-lines, a shipwright's rule at the belt.
portrait.colours: Lagoon teal (#2f8a8a), sun gold (#e0b23a), shell white (#f0e8cc).

ruler.formerName: Soyai (named after the realm; renamed under the place-name rule)

heir.note: No heir: the Archipelago Council chooses a Tide-Speaker from the isles' shipwrights and pilots.

advisors.name: Elan of Ossi Luni
advisors.role: Leads the shipwrights of Ossi Luni who build Gala's white ships.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man with an adze beside a white hull.

advisors.name: Sanga of the Reef Line
advisors.role: Keeps the reef line by which the Noon Council divided the strait with Ihuy, and watches Ihuy's boats along it.
advisors.portrait: An elf on a reef with a sounding-line.

advisors.name: Elang, Envoy to Sodoli
advisors.role: Carries the council's ship-contracts to King Lorien's court and brings back the Gala's orders, which are few and courteous.
advisors.portrait: An elf-man in white with a ship-contract case.

commanders.name: Selang of the White Ships
commanders.role: Commands the archipelago's white ships on the Bright Sea.
commanders.portrait: An elf captain on the deck of a white ship.

commanders.name: Heli of Ileslia
commanders.role: Commands the guard of the council isle.
commanders.portrait: A tall elf-man with a spear on a white quay.

ruler.name: Senan of Elgagen
ruler.bio: Senan is a farmer's son who became spokesman of the guest-towns of Goodin by settling a water quarrel without a single steading leaving the moot. He speaks for the Sunfolk of the western grass, with Goodton and Guuden, and his is the only realm of the Lands of the Sun that raises levies freely, which makes it the strongest arm the Noon Council has. Goodin sits at the council only as a guest, and Senan means to ask for a full seat before he dies; he has not yet decided how.

portrait.appearance: A tall, sun-browned Sunfolk man with a broad weathered face and grey-streaked hair.
portrait.dress: A plain farmer's tunic and a guest-town elder's yellow sash, a staff of grassland oak.

heir.note: No heir: the guest-towns choose their elders, and the elders one to speak for them.

advisors.name: Elan of Goodton
advisors.role: Elder of the steadings of Goodton, which joined the guest-towns and still likes its own way.
advisors.portrait: A grey-haired farmer-man with a yellow sash.

advisors.name: Rangin, Master of the Levy
advisors.role: Raises the levies of the western grass, which come when they are called.
advisors.portrait: A broad farmer with a spear and a horn.

advisors.name: Hele the Reckoner
advisors.role: Keeps the Reckoning of the Twelve for the guest-towns and the wells the council granted every steading.
advisors.portrait: An old man with a calendar-cord of twelve knots and a lamp.

commanders.name: Captain Hengan of the Grass
commanders.role: Leads the Sunfolk levies of the western grass, the only host in the region raised without asking twice.
commanders.portrait: A tall Sunfolk captain with a long spear and a yellow sash.

commanders.name: Heli of Guuden
commanders.portrait: A Sunfolk archer with a grass-woven quiver.

name: God Forest
stanceNote: No row in countries.csv; a closed wood whose keepers decline the Noon Council reads as Seclusion. Owner to confirm.

ruler.name: The Keepers of the God Forest
ruler.bio: A small household of secluded elves keeps the God Forest, and no ruler of it is named; the Keepers speak to outsiders only through whoever meets them at the wood's edge. They closed the wood to every outsider after Dardan, and when the Noon Council was founded they sent the Radiant Speaker's invitation back tied with a living vine. The Sunhot treat their silence as holy, and the Sunfolk avoid the forest edge after dark.

portrait.appearance: An emblem, not a figure: a dark wood seen from its edge, a single lantern hung on a branch.
portrait.colours: Forest dark (#1f4a3a), lantern gold (#e8d070), pale light (#f0f0e0).

ruler.note: No Keeper is named and their kin is open (Sunhot, Gala or their own); the leader is an emblem. No advisors or commanders are named for the same reason.

heir.note: Not applicable: no ruler is named.

notes: Advisors and commanders stay generated (emblem portraits) until the owner rules on the Keepers' kin.
